_comment: Capability profiles for AI clients (Claude Code, Cursor, any MCP host).
Each entry is the SAME server with a different MDCP_PROFILE, so a reviewer
looking at one sponsor track mounts only that track's capabilities.
Enable the one you care about; you do not need the others.
Requires: cd app && npm install, and app/.env filled in (see app/.env.example).
Verify what a profile mounts without an AI client: ./mdcp surface hedera
